payload.title: Scaffold the alexa plugin: per-site Lambda endpoint behind a site config switch
payload.description: Add amplify/plugins/alexa (config.ts, papyrus.plugin.ts, function/resource.ts, function/handler.py) following the reader-steering layout. Off by default. The Lambda permission allows only alexa-appkit.amazon.com with the skill-ID event source condition. Outputs the function ARN for the skill manifest. Gherkin: the plugin is absent when off; the endpoint rejects a request with the wrong skill ID.
